name: Outgoings Desk
office_task: Each year, when a commercial tenant's outgoings are reconciled, work out their share from the lease, draft the recovery invoice in Xero, park any unclear share, and hold it for the manager.
systems_of_record: the property management system that holds each commercial lease, its recoverable outgoings and the tenant's share, and issues one outgoings reconciliation record per tenancy per outgoings year (carried as job_id, with the tenancy_id on it), which the property manager marks final
the building's outgoings schedule for the year, actual and budget per category, kept as the agency's Xero items for that building

emits.write: One draft recovery invoice in Xero per tenancy per outgoings year, referenced job:<reconciliation id>, one line per outgoings category the reconciliation carries at the tenant's lease share of that year's actual, less the same share of the budget the tenant paid instalments on, every figure read from the year's outgoings schedule at draft time and the signed deed of variation attached for any share changed mid-year. Xero applies GST from the items. A second final event updates the same draft.
emits.readback: Xero returns the InvoiceID; GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} must return the invoice with Reference job:<reconciliation id>, and that id is stamped on the reconciliation as seam.invoice_id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The recovery invoice leaves only after the property manager releases it by name, or under a rule and threshold they wrote down (none by default); the release and the send time are recorded against the reconciliation. The bot never approves or emails in Xero itself.
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns it AUTHORISED and sent to the tenant's contact, and the reconciliation read by its id shows seam.released_by (a person or a rule) before the send time. A send with no release on the record is refused.

emits.write: A parked or waiting recovery as an exception on the reconciliation: the reason from the standard's list (not_in_pricebook for a category the year's schedule does not hold or a share the lease does not record, unsigned_variation, write_failed), over_threshold for a draft waiting on the manager, or credit_due when instalments already cover the share, with the reconciliation id, the invoice id, the categories left unbilled and exception_owner set to the property manager named for outgoings.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id, the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; the next run reads it there and stops until exception.closed.
